data.skills:
• Strong hands-on experience with precision motion control systems and servo mechanisms
• Proven track record of designing and building electromechanical systems from concept to deployment
• Experience with feedback control systems (PID, LQR, or similar)
• Proficiency in CAD software (SolidWorks, Fusion 360, or similar)
• Hands-on experience with motors, actuators, encoders, and precision stages
• Experience with microcontrollers/embedded systems for motion control
• Knowledge of sensor integration (IMUs, gyroscopes, encoders, cameras)
• Proficiency with fabrication tools (CNC machining, 3D printing, workshop tools) 
• Experience with MATLAB/Simulink for control system simulation
• Programming skills in Python, C/C++ for embedded control systems
• Self-motivated with ability to own subsystems end-to-end
• Knowledge of \control systems theory and real time implementation preferred
• Experience with optical tracking systems, gimbal design, or pointing systems
• Knowledge of fast steering mirrors, tip-tilt platforms, or stabilization techniques
• Familiarity with vibration analysis, isolation, and damping systems
• Understanding of optical alignment requirements and beam propagation
• Experience with ruggedized mechanical design for outdoor/aerospace applications
• Knowledge of Kalman filtering, state estimation, predictive control
data.eligibility_information: • B.Tech/M.Tech in Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, Aerospace Engineering or related field
data.additional_information: Join us in developing precision mechanical systems and motion control platforms for optical communication hardware. You will design and build electromechanical systems including positioning mechanisms, servo control systems, and mechanically stable platforms across various projects. This role involves hands-on work integrating mechanics, electronics, and control systems for field-deployable platforms supporting terrestrial and space-based applications.
